next_step_summary: PR #222 is a bounded safety corrective for defects proven by targeted audit of PR #221 and a pre-Ready counter-regression. Boundary occupancy is evaluated directly in fixed-frame deskew coordinates so the accepted 1-degree, sole content_touches_frame, roughly 15-percent clear-background case can reach cropped_grayscale without post-rotation AABB inflation. Recovery fails closed when meaningful paper-classified pixels or a substantial intermediate-luminance shadow band remains outside the proposed crop. A polarity-outlier corner is ignored only when both active runs localize it away from the adjacent frame edges; otherwise physical corner evidence remains safety-relevant. This preserves the PR #220 deskewed full-frame fallback for shadowed, trapezoidal, corner-tip or otherwise uncertain physical edges. Focused synthetic production-Kotlin checks cover the top-left trapezoid tip and compact mark, shadow/signature and trapezoid/signature fallback, the clear 1-degree crop path, normal and inverted polarity, 3:1 support and ambiguous 2:2 rejection. Existing normal accepted safe-crop behavior, angle estimation, perspective behavior, OCR/network/provider/dependency/permission/workflow behavior and privacy boundary are unchanged. Continue android-document-preprocess-device-smoke-v1 on the owner-controlled photographed regression page and contract sets; no real-device PASS is recorded by PR #222.
